conclusion.label: endorses

report:
### Conclusion
**Yes**, clinical evidence supports using honey to help relieve acute coughs in children, but **only for those aged 1 year and older**. Research shows honey can reduce cough frequency and severity, often performing better than placebo or no treatment and comparably or better than several over-the-counter cough medications.

### Summary of Evidence
* **Effectiveness:** Systematic reviews and clinical trials show that honey thins mucus and calms coughs caused by upper respiratory tract infections (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10570220/, https://www.mayoclinic.org/symptoms/cough/expert-answers/honey/faq-20058031). Evidence evaluated in Cochrane reviews indicates honey decreases cough frequency more effectively than placebo or no treatment, and slightly better than medications such as diphenhydramine (https://www.cochrane.org/evidence/CD007094_honey-acute-cough-children).
* **Pediatric Recommendations:** Pediatric guidelines recommend offering 2 to 5 mL of honey as needed to help thin mucus and ease coughing in children older than 1 year (https://www.healthychildren.org/English/health-issues/conditions/chest-lungs/Pages/Coughs-and-Colds-Medicines-or-Home-Remedies.aspx).

### Critical Safety Warning
Honey **must never** be given to infants under 12 months of age. Infants under 1 year old have immature digestive and immune systems, making them vulnerable to *Clostridium botulinum* spores found in honey, which can cause severe infant botulism (https://www.cochrane.org/evidence/CD007094_honey-acute-cough-children, https://www.healthychildren.org/English/health-issues/conditions/chest-lungs/Pages/Coughs-and-Colds-Medicines-or-Home-Remedies.aspx).

### Sources
* PMC Systematic Review: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10570220/
* Cochrane Review Evidence: https://www.cochrane.org/evidence/CD007094_honey-acute-cough-children
* Mayo Clinic: https://www.mayoclinic.org/symptoms/cough/expert-answers/honey/faq-20058031
* HealthyChildren.org (AAP): https://www.healthychildren.org/English/health-issues/conditions/chest-lungs/Pages/Coughs-and-Colds-Medicines-or-Home-Remedies.aspx
